note: Pin constraints transcribed from Espressif datasheets and the ESP-IDF GPIO documentation. Only facts that are unambiguous across every module variant are encoded here; board-specific quirks (on-board LEDs, USB bridges) are intentionally excluded.

strapping.0: must be HIGH at boot, pulled LOW selects the serial bootloader
strapping.2: must be LOW or floating at boot, also drives the on-board LED on many boards
strapping.5: must be HIGH at boot, it latches the SDIO timing
strapping.12: must be LOW at boot on 3.3 V flash modules, HIGH selects 1.8 V and the board will not boot
strapping.15: must be HIGH at boot, pulling it LOW silences the boot log

notes.not_on_wroom: GPIO16/17 exist only on WROVER modules, they are wired to the PSRAM on WROOM.

strapping.0: must be HIGH at boot, pulled LOW selects the serial bootloader
strapping.3: must be floating or HIGH at boot, it selects the JTAG signal source
strapping.45: must be LOW at boot, it selects the VDD_SPI voltage
strapping.46: must be LOW at boot, it enables the ROM boot messages

notes.usb: GPIO19/GPIO20 are the native USB D-/D+ pins; using them as plain GPIO disables USB CDC.
notes.octal_psram: Modules with octal PSRAM additionally reserve GPIO33-37.

strapping.8: must be HIGH at boot, it selects the boot mode
strapping.9: must be HIGH at boot, it enables the ROM boot messages
